meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 通过专门的 GitHub 机器人账号出现在 PR 和 issue 评论里。别人在评论里 @ 机器人,Claude 就回复;首次 @ 后持续关注该线程,回应后续评论。每个 PR/issue 是独立会话。
howto.when: 收到 GitHub 的 PR/issue 评论事件,且评论里精确 @ 到机器人账号时触发;首次 @ 后该线程被订阅,后续评论也会触发。严格模式下仅已登记成员能触发。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 渠道接进来,机器人账号用 my-org-bot
say.note: 触发 add-github,开始复制适配器、配置凭据

say.text: 配置 GitHub 渠道,监控 acme/backend,私有仓库
say.note: 私有仓库会用宽松策略,不额外限制评论者

say.text: 给 GitHub 渠道加上严格模式,只让已登记成员触发
say.note: 对应公共仓库的 strict 策略,需添加成员白名单

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude participates in GitHub PR/issue comments via a dedicated bot account: it replies when @-mentioned and keeps following the thread after the first mention. Each PR/issue is its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers via webhook when someone exactly @-mentions the bot account in a PR/issue comment; after the first mention the thread stays subscribed. In strict mode only registered members can trigger.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel for me, bot account my-org-bot
say_en.note: Starts setup: copies adapter and guides credentials.

say_en.text: Configure the GitHub channel for acme/backend, private repo
say_en.note: Private repos use the permissive unknown-sender policy.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel in strict mode, only registered members trigger it
say_en.note: Strict mode for public repos; guides adding members.
